programme.desc: Who's got rhythm? We all do! All of our friends are making music! What instrument is Blue going to play in Blue's Big Band?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Today we're playing store! Our friends have set up pretend stores and preschoolers help Joe shop for everything on his is. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to get at the store.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Perwinkle and Blue found a bird's egg in a nest in the backyard! It's not quite ready to hatch, so we need to be patient and wait. While we wait we play Blue's Clues to figure out what to do to pass the time.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Shh! It's Joe's birthday and everyone's planning a surprise party! The characters in the house need our help to get things ready - but something is missing. Let's play Blue's Clues to figure out what else we need to do.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: All aboard! Everyone's in the backyard building an Alphabet Train. The train is made up of lots of boxes-one for each letter- and we need to help find something for each box. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what will work.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: It's a big day today - Blue's going to the doctor for her annual checkup! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do after her checkup.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Today we're counting things throughout the house and labeling them with big numbers. We learn that Joe's favorite number is one. But what's Blue's favorite? We play Blue's Clues to figure out which number is Blue's favorite!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Where is Baby Bird? Over or under Joe's head? On or off the branch? Using relational concepts, we help Joe find Baby Bird. Blue wants to find something too, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Wow, you're over pretty late today. Joe's stuffed duck Boris is ready for his favorite part of bedtime, getting tucked in, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue's favorite part of bedtime is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What's going to happen next? Some big event seems to be brewing on the patio, but we're not sure what. Blue has an idea, though, so we play Blue's Clues to predict what's going to happen on the patio.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Everybody is dressing up today! Blue is being a giraffe, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants us to be! Joe tries different costumes throughout the day - does he want to be an explorer, robot, or a duck?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We're making a giant story on the wall with pictures! It's about some rabbits who go on a trip to visit their grandma. But what will the rabbits do once they get to her house? Blue knows! We play Blue's Clues to figure it out!

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dans le but d'utiliser les toilettes des filles pour échapper aux toilettes bondés des garçons, Cartman annonce qu'il est transgenre. Pendant ce temps, Randy se démène avec sa double identité de Lorde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le nouveau service de transport de Timmy destiné à recueillir des fonds pour le camp d'été lui fait beaucoup d'ennemis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman découvre les drônes et en profite pour filmer l'intimité des habitants de South Park. Ce qui va entraîner une paranoïa autour de l'utilisation des drônes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan devient accro au nouveau jeu sur mobile produit par le Canada, mettant en scène Terrance et Philippe. L'application est dite 'gratuite' mais propose de dépenser de l'argent pour progresser dans le jeu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman a acheté l'Oculus Rift et les enfants ne savent plus s'ils sont dans le monde réel ou dans le monde virtuel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny excelle dans le jeu de carte Magic : l'assemblée ou les combats de coqs font rage dans les milieux underground. Randy, pensant qu'il s'agit de tout autre chose mais se trompe.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ike ne veut plus jouer avec Kyle à Call of Duty et préfère regarder des personnes jouant et commentant le jeu sur YouTube

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les hologrammes de stars décédées envahissent la télévision : le monde court à la catastrophe dont il ne pourrait jamais se relever.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les garçons expriment tout le respect qu'ils ont pour Caitlyn Jenner dans cette épisode de la série South Park, plus magnifique et courageuse que jamais.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: M. Garrison veut construire un mur pour tenir à distance les immigrants sans papiers.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ville de South Park entreprend d'importantes rénovations. De son côté, Kenny pense qu'il est temps pour lui de chercher un travail.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman est persuadé d'être le meilleur critique gastronomique du net que South Park ait connu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se fait humilier sur les réseaux sociaux à cause de son poids.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les élèves asiatiques de l'école représentent en peinture l'amour imaginaire entre Tweek et Craig.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park ne veulent plus de policiers dans leur ville.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy, le rédacteur en chef du journal de l'école, se heurte à l'opinion un peu obtue de Principal PC.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Principal PC disparaît avec deux élèves de CM1.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle mène son combat aux côtés d'une alliée dangereuse au détriment de son amitié avec Stan.
programme.sub-title: Le jugement final de Principal PC

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La poire à lavement devance le sandwich au caca dans la course à la présidence, et cela ne l'arrange pas. J.J. Abrams a pour mission de faire un reboot de l'hymne américain et Kyle veut démasquer le troll qui harcèle les filles de l'école

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le troll chasseauxgarces42 sévit toujours. Les filles sont de plus en plus remontées et menacent les garçons de répliquer si le harcèlement continue. Ceux-ci sont persuadés que Cartman est responsable et ils comptent bien l'arrêter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tous deux privés de technologie, Cartman et Heidi se lient d'amitié. La guerre est ouverte entre Freja Ollegard et chasseauxgarces42 qui a peur d'être découvert. M. Garrison fait tout pour ne pas être élu président.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Alors que Kyle soutient les filles, Butters préfère mener la révolte des garçons. Kyle demande l'aide de Cartman, mais ce dernier refuse. L'identité de Gerald a été découverte par un autre troll qui le met en garde face aux Danois.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les trolls s'unissent pour contrecarrer les plans des Danois. Cartman et Heidi encouragent les élèves de l'école à se serrer les coudes, tandis que M. Garrison s'attire la colère de ses sympathisants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman et Heidi révèlent leur plan à Kyle. Grâce à Heidi, les Danois lancent leur site. Un premier troll est découvert à Fort Collins. Randy et M. Garrison tentent de détruire sans succès les Rappel-baies qui passent alors à l'action.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le pays est sous le choc du résultat des élections. Gerald est envoyé en mission secrète au Danemark par Mme Clinton afin d'utiliser le site anti-trolls contre M. Garrison. Bill Clinton et Bill Cosby font la morale aux élèves de l'école.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Rappel-baies envahissent la Maison-Blanche. M. Garrison prend ses fonctions mais ne sait pas quoi faire face à l'attaque des Danois. Gerald force Ike à troller à sa place. Cartman et Heidi font la queue pour aller sur Mars.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle convainc les habitants de South Park de demander au président de bombarder le Danemark, mais le regrette très vite. Gerald obtient un entretien avec le soi-disant chasseur de trolls danois. Cartman a peur de perdre Heidi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman a percé le secret des femmes et veut empêcher les hommes d'aller sur Mars. Gerald affronte le chasseur de trolls en face à face. De son côté, Kyle tente de sauver le monde.
programme.sub-title: Rien ne sera plus jamais comme avant

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy découvre ce que cela signifie d'être blanc dans la société d'aujourd'hui.
programme.sub-title: Des blancs qui rénovent des maisons

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Corée du Nord prend South Park comme cible.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un lien indéniable se crée entre un homme blanc et un Amérindien.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Facebook est l'arme ultime pour le Professor Chaos.
programme.sub-title: Le prequel du Coon et sa bande

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Des artistes adorés sont fauchés en pleine jeunesse à cause d'énormes overdoses d'opiacés. Stan est sur le point d'être balancé comme dealer de drogue.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Au rassemblement annuel pour Halloween, une sorcière lance un sort qui terrorise tout le monde à South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle joue avec le feu en s'interposant dans la relation de Cartman et Heidi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'expérience de Jimmy et de Timmy pourrait leur rapporter le premier prix à la foire annuelle des sciences.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the rest of the Straw Hats continue to fight bravely, Luffy tries to find a way to save the island, and the horrible truth about Hordy's hatred for humans is finally revealed!
programme.sub-title: A SHOCKING FACT! THE TRUE IDENTITY OF HORDY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Hordy's twisted past takes center stage in a Fish-Man flashback. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi's brother begs Luffy to save his beloved homeland and wipe out the anti-human element!
programme.sub-title: BACK TO ZERO! EARNEST WISHES FOR LUFFY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's fist of fire puts Hordy down for the count, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of the remaining Fish-Man Pirates. Meanwhile, a very big boat looms overhead!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY'S ALL-OUT ATTACK! RED HAWK BLASTS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of their enemies, Luffy summons the strength for one last brutal attack on Hordy. Now, about that giant boat…
programme.sub-title: COMING TO AN END! THE FINAL DECISIVE BATTLE AGAINST HORDY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After defeating Hordy, Luffy turns his attention to stopping the Noah from crushing Fish-Man Island. Straw Hats and Fish-Men alike watch as Luffy tries to obliterate a boat with a barrage of brutal blows!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Fish-Man Island was saved by the timely arrival of the Sea Kings, but all is not well. Luffy lost a lot of blood in his battle with Hordy, and fish-to-human transfusions are strictly forbidden!
programme.sub-title: TO THE FUTURE! THE PATH TO THE SUN!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jimbei must decide whether or not to join the Straw Hats, and the grateful citizens of Fish-Man Island host a fabulous banquet in honor of their human heroes!
programme.sub-title: THE SECRET REVEALED! THE TRUTH ABOUT THE ANCIENT WEAPON!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew learn of epic battle between Aokiji and Akainu, a forgotten foe tries to kidnap the mermaid princess, and Hordy's gang finally gets what's coming to them!
programme.sub-title: THE STRAW HATS STUNNED! THE NEW FLEET ADMIRAL OF THE NAVY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji stumble upon a couple of Big Mam's henchmen extorting sweets from the peaceful people of Fish-Man Island, the Straw Hats make a new – and very powerful – enemy!
programme.sub-title: SHE LOVES SWEETS! BIG MOM OF THE FOUR EMPERORS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats prepare to depart Fish-Man Island, a lion and a caribou come to blows over booby-trapped treasure, and Vice Admiral Smoker makes his presence felt in the New World!
programme.sub-title: MANY PROBLEMS LIE AHEAD! A TRAP AWAITING IN THE NEW WORLD!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew bid farewell to their new friends before setting off in search of the greatest adventures the New World has to offer!
programme.sub-title: FINALLY TIME TO GO! GOODBYE, FISHMAN ISLAND!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Usopp's extreme deep sea fishing adventure lands the crew in the middle of a deadly whirlpool, but an unexpected encounter with a pod of giant whales may bail the Straw Hats out of hot water!
programme.sub-title: TO THE NEW WORLD! HEADING FOR THE ULTIMATE SEA!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's arrival in the New World is marked by violent weather and the discovery of a tiny stowaway. When the Straw Hats agree to help their new friend, it could lead to big trouble with the Marines!
programme.sub-title: Z’s Ambition! Lily the Little Giant!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami hatches a plan to save Lily's father, but the arrival of an ex-marine madman throws a monkey wrench into the rescue mission.
programme.sub-title: Z’s Ambition! A Dark and Powerful Army!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro find themselves locked in battle with their latest foes, but Nami's knowledge of the sea may be the key to escaping this scrum alive!
programme.sub-title: Z’s Ambition! A Great and Desperate Escape Plan!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shuzo's squad of manned torpedoes targets the Straw Hats and the giants! The crazed captain tests Luffy's mettle in a showdown on land, but the wily pirate pulls off a supersized surprise in hopes to stomp out the madman for good

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A desperate cry for help leads the Straw Hats to Punk Hazard, an island engulfed in flames and inhabited by a mythic beast that could make short work of Luffy and the gang!
programme.sub-title: Arriving! A Burning Island – Punk Hazard!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro put their strength to the ultimate test in a battle with a dragon. Meanwhile, a band of mysterious intruders make their gassy presence felt aboard the Sunny!
programme.sub-title: A Battle in the Heat! Luffy vs. the Giant Dragon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy gets up close and personal with a torso-less Samurai! Elsewhere, Nami, Sanji, Chopper, and Franky find themselves imprisoned with the pieces of a human face!
programme.sub-title: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samurai’s Horrifying Severed Head!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy makes friends with a Centaur, Franky uses a cola-powered laser to break out of the clink, and Sanji takes a chance on a body-less Samurai!
programme.sub-title: Startling! The Secret of the Island Is Finally Revealed!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami's soft spot for children prompts her to call off the escape and declare war on anyone who makes a kid cry. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang take a banana boat to the icy side of the island!
programme.sub-title: Save the Children! The Straw Hats Start to Fight!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's group finds themselves up against a gang of centaurs, Brook battles the torso of a surly samurai, and Captain Smoker encounters someone highly unexpected!
programme.sub-title: A Swordplay Showdown! Brook vs. the Mysterious Torso Samurai!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami and Chopper seek a safe exit for the children, Luffy's group hopes to avoid a perilous plunge into icy waters, and Captain Smoker faces off against Trafalgar Law!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's group takes a deadly plunge into icy waters, and Trafalgar Law uses his unique abilities to rearrange Nami's group and cast our heroes into chaotic confusion!
programme.sub-title: In a Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks into the Ice-Cold Lake!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Luffy and his mates race toward a reunion, Admiral Smoker struggles to survive a heart-stopping showdown with Trafalgar Law!
programme.sub-title: A Collision! Law vs. Vice Admiral Smoker!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy is excited to once again cross paths with Trafalgar Law, but a reunion with his mixed up crew – and the loss of his extra legs – quickly dampens the captain's enthusiasm!
programme.sub-title: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Captain Smoker determines his next move, a very large pirate with alligator legs tells Luffy and the Straw Hats the true story of Punk Hazard's mysterious transformation!
programme.sub-title: The Worst in the World! A Scientist of Terror - Caesar!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Toriko, Luffy, and Goku's three-way tie in the World's Best Eating Competition, the festivities are interrupted by the sudden appearance of a monster that threatens to consume every living thing on earth.
programme.sub-title: History’s Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The giant children fly into a mysterious rage, and Chopper discovers the true reason for their unusual condition! Meanwhile, Zoro, Brook, and Sanji cross paths with a dangerous duo!
programme.sub-title: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The story of how Trafalgar Law arrived at Punk Hazard is revealed, and the Yeti Cool Brothers set their sights on a showdown with the Straw Hats!
programme.sub-title: To Annihilate the Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy tries to chase down the Yetti Cool Brothers, but Franky – still trapped in Chopper's Body – makes his mission extremely difficult. Just when all appears lost, an unexpected ally lends a hand!
programme.sub-title: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight on the Snow-Capped Mountains!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy agrees to an alliance with Trafalgar Law, but the Straw Hats refuse to leave the island until the children are safe. Meanwhile, the gaseous master unleashes something very deadly!
programme.sub-title: Formed! Luffy and Law's Pirate Alliance!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro, Sanji, and Brook continue their search for the samurai, Trafalgar tries to sneak Chopper into the laboratory, and Luffy boldly challenges the Master!
programme.sub-title: Capture M! The Pirate Alliance's Operation Launches!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's battle with his old nemesis Smoker is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying toxic blob – and the evil genius who created the monster!
programme.sub-title: On the Verge of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack: Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the Library. Can they reach the Library before it closes?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bugga Bugga: Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Fish Out of Water: Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Little Star: Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Prince: Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken: Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off on an educational adventure to meet him.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: El Coqui: In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Stuck Truck: Calling all trucks! Boots sure loves trucks. When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue. Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Louder!: What are we going to do? Cockledoodledoo! Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun. Along the way we practice making lots of noise.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Roberto The Robot: Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Potato: Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Journey To The Purple Planet: Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Lost City: Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Meet Diego!: Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Save The Puppies: Woof! Woof! Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies." A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages. To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ¡Por Favor!: Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou - a cute and cuddly forest creature - who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Dino: Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island. It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs. Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots' Special Day: Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots most favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: To The South Pole: Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin! It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Pingüino all the way back home to the South Pole.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Game: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What Happens Next?: What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue: Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boot's Cuddly Dinosaur: It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Super Silly Fiesta: Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats and even silly dancing.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Fix-It Machine: Uh oh! Boots has a hole - un hoyo - in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baseball Boots: Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs - from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind, and snow!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Dora's cousin Daisy's 15th birthday party, her quinceañera! But the party can't start without Dora and Boots - they need to teach everybody the mambo!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Tales of Leo: The Turtles, Splinter, Casey and April just barely manage to escape from the explosion that destroys the antique store. They hit the road and hide out at Casey's grandmother's old farmhouse, but Leonardo is badly wounded.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Monster Hunter: Still recuperating up at Casey's grandmother's farm, the turtles are feeling the sting of boredom. Luckily, a scientist known as the "Monster Hunter" has come to the area searching for a legendary monster…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to New York - Part 1: The Turtles return to New York (as the title might suggest) with one goal in mind: to destroy the Shredder once and for all.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to New York - Part 2: The Turtles and Splinter continue to fight their way up through the Foot Headquarters skyscraper, facing down three misshapen Mutant Shredder Clones, a hallway of traps, and the Mystic Ninja.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to New York - Part 3: With Stockman showing up in the middle of the final battle between our heroes and the Shredder, everything is thrown into chaos … so much so that our heroes must join forces with the Shredder and Hun to defeat Stockman.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Lone Raph & Cub: With Splinter mysteriously vanished last episode, the Turtles are feeling frustrated, not knowing where to start looking for him. Impatient with strategizing, Raph heads off on his own, and runs into a solo adventure.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Search for Splinter Part 1: After the frustrated Turtles exhaust their search for Splinter, their suspicions turn to the Guardians, and the trail soon leads them to a non-descript building, the initials of its company name spelling out "TCRI."

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Search for Splinter Part 2: The Turtles successfully infiltrate the mysterious TCRI Building, where they manage to sneak into its inner sanctum, and locate the unconscious Splinter inside a stasis tank.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 1 The Fugitoid: Our four heroes find themselves beamed halfway across the universe to the planet D'Hoonnib and right into the middle of a police action! There, they befriend the Fugitoid, a.k.a. Professor Honeycutt.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 1 The Fugitoid

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 2 The Trouble with Triceratons: On the planet D'Hoonnib, the Turtles team up with the Fugitoid, a.k.a. Professor Honeycutt, who is being pursued by the rogue military forces of General Blanque.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 2 The Trouble with Triceratons

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 3 The Big House: The Turtles are captured by the Triceratons and thrown into a Tri prison, their lives to be used as a bargaining chip to convince the Fugitoid to build his Teleportal device.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 3 The Big House

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 4 The Arena: Welcome to the Tri-sports Arena filled to capacity with cheering Triceraton crowds thirsty to watch grueling combat. Our four heroes have been sentenced to become gladiators in ruthless competition.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 4 The Arena

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 5 Triceraton Wars: With Professor Honeycutt (the Fugitoid) safely in tow and the Prime Leader as a hostage, the turtles are faced with their biggest challenge yet!
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 5 Triceraton Wars

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 1: Back from their adventures in space, the Turtles find themselves in the headquarters of the same aliens who teleported them across the universe! The discovery of an old friend and new allies leads to a trip back through time.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 2: The turtles and Splinter have taken a little trip down the Utroms' memory lane via a high-tech virtual reality device experiencing first hand the Utroms' crash landing on Earth and their life in feudal Japan.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 3: The Turtles and Splinter escape the Utroms' high-tech virtual reality device, only to find the Shredder and all his forces waiting for them. All shell breaks loose in yet another final showdown between our heroes and the Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Reflections: Catching up on some much-needed rest, our heroes take a little trip to Casey's grandma's farmhouse as well as a little trip down memory lane. But, every memory is haunted by the same dark figure … the Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Ultimate Ninja: There's a bad dude in town, and he's looking to pick a fight with Leonardo. This Ultimate Ninja has come halfway across the inter-dimensional universe to fight the Shredder, defeat him and gain glory.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Modern Love - The Return of Nano: The Turtles are in big trouble from a microscopic enemy when the bizarre Nano-monster returns! When the self-replicating techno-nightmare springs his criminal "father" out of jail and goes on another rampage.
programme.sub-title: Modern Love - The Return of Nano

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: What a Croc!: The Turtles discover that they're not alone in the sewer. The green ooze which mutated them years ago also claimed another victim… Leather Head!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to the Underground: The Turtles return to the ancient underground city they discovered in "Notes From the Underground" -- only to find the city abandoned, its crystal moon power source missing, and its human population reverted to monsters.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 1: With the Shredder gone, underworld factions clash for power in a gang war that threatens to tear the city apart!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.desc: Kate and Mei Lin are thrilled to tour the solar system with Pal's cousin, Dr. Yowl. Wally is missing and Elwood City's best detective is on the case. And that detective is…Binky?!?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Aliens, conspiracy theories, the megatoad--Buster believes in everything, until his favorite show gets cancelled for false reporting. Dogs love Arthur! Well, except Carrot Cake. Can Arthur win over this picky pup?
programme.sub-title: Buster Isn't Buying It/One Ornery Critter

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Maria has always been a silent fixture in Mr. Ratburn's third-grade class. But her time to speak has finally come. Can she fix her stutter? When Binky's grandparents miss his big soccer game, he decides to film a video reenactment.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Carl has agreed to play the accordion for George's puppet show. But his routines are getting in the way of rehearsals. Buster enlists Binky's help to keep him from gorging on delicious Tuvaluna cookies. Will Buster's self-control crumble?
programme.sub-title: Carl's Concerto/Too Much of a Good Thing

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Francine needs money for new soccer cleats, Muffy hires her as a personal assistant. Lydia and Muffy join forces to defeat a mean beauty queen in the Little Miss Crocus" pageant.
programme.sub-title: Francine's Cleats of Strength/Little Miss Meanie

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Mysterious calls. Superhuman strength. Is Mr. Ratburn secretly a superhero? When Buster and Ladonna bond over a memorable trip to the movies, Arthur feels left out. Has Ladonna taken his place as Buster's best bud?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's a time of change at Lakewood Elementary as Arthur and Buster move up to 4th grade. D.W. and Bud prepare to enter kindergarten and Muffy and Francine contemplate how spending the summer away from each other will affect their friendship.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: With the help of a little time travel, Buster turns back the clock to see what his life would be like if he were a genius. Arthur isn't happy when he discovers that Buster has been telling him some white lies, just to spare his feelings.
programme.sub-title: Buster's Second Chance/Arthur and the Whole Truth

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Will Fern give up her dreams of being a writer just because of one silly rejection? Buster tells the story of a missing cereal box on his all-new podcast. Will he be able to find the thief--and in the process--the truth?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A special episode of Bionic Bunny is interrupted, and Arthur and friends try to remember what comes next. D.W. is excited to be taking care of the class bunny, Larry. But Larry is feeling adventurous and and wanders off.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Bud falls in love with a snazzy new pair of boots, he might face his toughest adventure yet - learning to tie his shoes. D.W. gets jealous when Grandma Thora becomes the most popular babysitter in town.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur, Buster, and Brain are worried when Mr. Ratburn isn't acting like himself. He's always pleased to see them, so what’s made him change? When Mr. Crosswire gets a robot butler for Father's Day, Muffy fears Bailey may be replaced.
programme.sub-title: Lend Me Your Ear/The Butler Did It

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: At the Elwood City Picnic, Prunella pretends she can see the future at her fortune telling booth. The Lakewood Elementary soccer team has had enough of Francine's bossy behavior.
programme.sub-title: Prunella's Tent of Portent/Mutiny on the Pitch

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Attention Lakewood Elementary! There's a new sheriff—er--hallway monitor-in town, and his name is George Lundgren. Ladonna Compson is friendly, funny, and full of personality. Everyone likes her! At least, that's what she thought.

programme.title: Arthur: Summer Stories
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate summer! Join Arthur as he takes a family vacation and visits Grandpa Dave’s farm. Then, Arthur, D.W. and Buster spend a few days at the beach where they discover the simple joys of building sandcastles!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Binky gets an "A" on a test, Muffy and Francine are convinced he cheated. Is it possible that he actually studied? Brain makes a time capsule and gets overwhelmed by people asking to have their special belongings included.
programme.sub-title: Binky's "A" Game/Brain and the Time Capsule

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster struggles to build a birdhouse that will save the community garden from pests, while Muffy and Francine design a cat toy that will really change the pet toy game.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Ladonna befriends a new member of the Mighty Mountain soccer team, Francine becomes convinced she is leaking secret team info. The City Council has voted to close the Elwood City Library! Can Sue Ellen save it before it's too late?
programme.sub-title: Francine and the Soccer Spy/Sue Ellen and the Last Page

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy worries that her friends don't need her anymore when they plan a successful bake sale without her. Arthur thinks Mrs. MacGrady is being treated unfairly, so he decides the best to take a stand is to take a seat.
